title: Owner's own physical impact / hitchhiker effect

tellings.quote: it's had a very real physical impact on people's lives, including mine.

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, says the place has had "a very real physical impact on people's lives, including mine," a version of what is called the hitchhiker effect, the idea that something from the ranch follows people away from it. He tells Michels this from his own experience, and if true it would mean whatever is at the ranch can harm people's bodies.
